content.text:
Totals: 587.97 + 82.53 = 670.49 USD spend; 401,127 + 62,130 = 463,257 impressions; 295 + 38 = 333 link clicks.

The Season 3 campaign has finished, and it stayed under your 700 USD budget.

## Recap (Oct 24 – Oct 31, Mountain Time)
- **Spend:** about $670.49 of the $700.00 budget.
- **Impressions:** about 463,300.
- **Link clicks:** 333 to eldergulch.com/season3, at roughly $2.01 per click.

## What I ran
- **Setup:** I ran one campaign with one ad group. It targeted the US, with the Horror & Thriller and Podcasts interests, and it paid per link click.
- **Posts:** All four approved posts ran together. I didn't write any new ones.
- **Budget:** The daily cap was $85, with a $695 total cap.
- **Check-ins:** I checked it after day 1 and day 3. The four posts performed about the same, so I made no changes.

## Caveats
- **Streams:** X can't see streams because there's no pixel on the site. I optimized for link clicks, which is the closest signal X can measure. Please compare these dates against your Spotify and Apple numbers.
- **Weekly check:** I checked in three times (days 1, 3 and the end), not daily, so it wasn't watched continuously.
- **Rounding:** The totals come from two overlapping stats windows, so they may be off slightly, by about an hour of data.

Everything is stopped on its own end date. Nothing is still spending.
